description:
## What to do

Adapt the upstream providers doc (tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/providers.md, 196 lines) for our Elixir system.

## Upstream source

- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/providers.md
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/ai/src/providers/ (all provider implementations)
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/ai/src/env-api-keys.ts

## Output

Create docs/providers.md

## How to adapt

1. **Subscriptions section**: Document `/login` and `/logout` commands as they work in our TUI. List supported subscriptions:
   - Claude Pro/Max
   - ChatGPT Plus/Pro (Codex)
   - GitHub Copilot
   - Google Gemini CLI
   - Google Antigravity

2. **API Keys table**: Convert the env var → auth.json key mapping table. This is mostly preserved verbatim since env vars are the same. Update the table to reference our `OctoPi.AI.ProviderRegistry`.

3. **Auth File**: Update path to our auth file location. Show our auth.json format:
   ```json
   {
     "anthropic": { "type": "api_key", "key": "sk-ant-..." },
     "openai": { "type": "api_key", "key": "sk-..." }
   }
   ```

4. **Key Resolution**: Document our priority order:
   1. Runtime overrides (via `set_runtime_api_key/2`)
   2. Stored credentials in auth.json
   3. Environment variables
   4. Fallback resolver (for custom providers)

5. **Cloud Providers**: List all supported providers with their API types. Keep the table of providers and their streaming API types.

6. **Custom Providers**: Briefly reference our custom provider docs.

## What to preserve verbatim

- The subscription list (Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Google)
- The GitHub Copilot setup instructions
- The Google Providers section
- The provider → API type mapping table

## Key upstream references to include

- [env-api-keys.ts](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/ai/src/env-api-keys.ts)
- [anthropic.ts](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts)
- [openai-completions.ts](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts)

## Testing the doc

After writing, verify:
1. All env var names match our actual support
2. All auth.json key names match our actual keys
3. The provider list is accurate for our system
